beats.text: You are Adalyn, and today you see a glowing trail outside your window—shimmering like stardust! Her heart jumps with excitement. What could it lead to?
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Now Adalyn, can you say the word 'you'?
beats.speaker: coach

beats.text: She puts on her rainbow boots, ready to go on an adventure. The sparkles wiggle like they’re waving at her, saying, 'Come on, you can do it!'
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: The path splits! One side hums like a happy bee, the other whispers like the wind. What should she do? She stops and wonders.
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Yay! You said 'go' when you were ready—just like Adalyn is ready to go on this big adventure!
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: Now Adalyn, say the word 'go'—let’s pick a path!
beats.speaker: coach
beats.coach_phrase: You’ve got the power to go!

beats.text: She chooses the humming path. It’s bumpy and twisty, and she trips once—but she gets back up. What matters is she keeps trying.
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: A tiny fox with silver paws appears. 'You’re stuck?' he asks. 'I know what helps—teamwork!' Her eyes light up. What a kind friend!
beats.speaker: parent

beats.text: This word is a little tricky—'see.' Watch my lips: S-EE. Can you say 'see'?
beats.speaker: coach
beats.coach_phrase: You’re doing so well—try it again!

beats.text: You did it! You said 'see,' 'go,' and 'her'—just in time! Together, Adalyn and the fox see the treasure: a garden glowing with laughter flowers! You all go home heroes!
beats.speaker: parent
